extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and research organisations in the UK seeking ESRC/UKRI funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for applying to ESRC/UKRI funding opportunities, including eligibility, funding limits, application windows, and the thematic scope of individual calls. Covers multiple open funding opportunities (invite-only and open calls) and their administrative conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only application requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The metascience scientometrics for research assessment opportunity is invite-only; only invited applicants may submit proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Host organisation eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be affiliated with an eligible UK research organisation to apply (explicitly stated for the 'Video games and gambling-related harms' opportunity). Check UKRI eligibility rules for which institutions qualify.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both listed opportunities are delivered as grants; applicants should prepare proposals appropriate to grant funding (budgeting, applicant track-record, project plan).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fund / programme budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Total fund: £3,000,000 (metascience call) / Total fund: £5,000,000 (video games and gambling harms call).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the total programme-level pot available to fund successful applications; may inform competition level and likely number/size of awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximum award / per-project cap
rubrics_metrics.description: Maximum award: £1,000,000 (video games and gambling-related harms call).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the largest single award an applicant can request under the call; proposals should ensure requested budgets do not exceed this cap.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full economic cost (FEC) funding level
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the metascience scientometrics opportunity, funder will cover 80% of full economic costs; applicants must account for remaining costs or eligible exceptions as per UKRI/ESRC FEC rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity status & application window
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication date, opening date, closing date (e.g., Publication date: 28 April 2026; Opening date: 28 April 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date: 2 June 2026 4:00pm UK time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted within the stated opening and closing dates/times; late submissions are not accepted. Note publication date for when full guidance becomes effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call scope and aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Call-specific research objectives: e.g., 'Apply for funding to develop, validate, and critique novel scientometric indicators for use in research assessment and in metascience research.'; 'Apply for funding to improve understanding of the relationship between gambling and video games and produce insights to inform policy and regulation, support interventions, and promote safe and responsible video games.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals must address the stated aims and themes of the call; alignment with the call's scope is a key eligibility/assessment factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of funders and co-funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Funders: UK Research and Innovation, Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC), NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC; Co-funders: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multi-council/co-funded calls may have additional expectations or cross-council considerations; applicants should review any co-funder-specific requirements in the full call text.
